Container.Name: Actual-Budget-Ingress
Container.Overview: A lightweight webhook listener bridge that accepts transaction payloads from n8n and directly injects them into your self-hosted Actual Budget instance using the official API client.

Config.Name: Container Port
Config.Description: The internal port the Express server listens on.

Config.Name: Ingress API Key
Config.Description: The secret key required in the X-Api-Key header to authorize n8n requests.

Config.Name: Actual Server URL
Config.Description: The URL of your self-hosted Actual Budget server instance.

Config.Name: Actual Server Password
Config.Description: The password used to log into your Actual Budget server.

Config.Name: Actual Sync ID
Config.Description: The unique Budget Sync ID (found under Advanced settings in your Actual Budget file).

Config.Name: Default Account Name
Config.Description: The fallback account name in Actual Budget if the incoming account cannot be matched dynamically.

Config.Name: Default Transaction Note
Config.Description: Enter the custom note to use for transactions that are added via this container

Config.Name: Logging Level
Config.Description: Sets the logging level of the server, 'debug','info','warn','error'
